sources.title: FREE Krea 2 Turbo 4-Step Distillation LoRA & ComfyUI Workflow ... - Patreon
sources.snippet: A community-trained LoRA that takes Krea 2 Turbo from 8 steps down to 4 — cutting generation time roughly in half while holding most of the quality. In my testing it kept image quality strong while bringing a generation down to under 20 seconds on 16 GB of VRAM. If you already run Krea 2 Turbo, this drops straight into your setup for a free speed boost.
